name: academic-harness
description: Academic Harness research tools, skills and writing guards, as a Claude Code mod.

research_mode.title: Research mode
research_mode.description: auto turns research mode on in a folder with an ah.yaml; on always; off never. /academic overrides it for one session.

tool_areas.title: Tool areas
tool_areas.description: Which tool groups the academic-harness server offers: search, papers, notebook, skills, writing, reviews, tournament, analysis, provenance, study, data, submission, deep, compute, figures, memory, or all. Comma separated.

restore_tools.title: Tools to bring back
restore_tools.description: Tools this plugin leaves out because Claude Code already does the job (see docs/FIT-REVIEW.md): brave_search, tavily_search, exa_search, perplexity_search, parallel_search, parallel_extract, consensus_search, elicit_search, scientific_result, fold_text, research_template, latex_compile. Comma separated; the tool's API key is then read from its environment variable.

llm_model.title: Model for tools that call a model
llm_model.description: deep_research, deep_review and the other tools that call a model run it through a headless Claude Code call under your login. The alias or id passed to --model (sonnet, opus, haiku, or a full model id).

llm_budget_usd.title: Model spend cap per server run (USD)
llm_budget_usd.description: The most the model route spends while the academic-harness server runs. A call past it fails with a message that says so. Each single call is also capped at 1 USD.

job_notices.title: When a background job ends
job_notices.description: deep_research, deep_review and analysis_run go on as background jobs. prompt: notify you and prompt the model to read the result and carry on. notify: notify only. off: neither (job_status and job_wait still work). Interactive sessions only.

evidence_check.title: Evidence check at the end of a turn
evidence_check.description: In a project with an ah.yaml, the stop gate can run an advisory check: a verifier model reads the sources cited by the paragraphs the turn changed (one model call per paragraph, and it only advises). skip never runs it; run runs it once per turn.
